equity.level_reason: Mammography percentages are reported across three family-income (FPL) groups and described as rising with income, but no difference or ratio is computed and no disparity is framed, so values set side by side cap the level at 2.

level_alternative.reason: Income is the report's sole exposure (an SDOH measure), so a contrast across it can meet level 3 without the word disparity; but no contrast is computed, only side-by-side percentages.

equity.equity_measurement: Income is expressed as percentage of FPL (family income and size, Census poverty thresholds) in three groups; income imputed when missing.

notes: The income groups are described with three side-by-side percentages and no computed difference or test, so the comparison scale is null and equity stays at level 2. No model, test or weighting is stated; CIs appear only as figure error bars with no method given. Mammography is coded as cancer (breast cancer screening), and family-income imputation is a data-handling rule, not a procedure.
view_issues: No CSV table was supplied, so the income-group values come from the text only; bar values beyond the text were not read.
